[[File:Jadwiga Zlotorzycka.jpg|thumb|Jadwiga Złotorzycka (1926-2002)]]
'''Jadwiga Zlotorzycka '''(1926–2002) was a Polish [[entomologist]] specialising in [[Mallophaga]].
She worked in the Parasitology Department of the [[University of Wroclaw]].

==Life and career==
Zlotorzycka was born in Warsaw, Poland in 1926 and grew up in Lviv, Ukraine. She began studying at the [[University of Wrocław|University of Wroclaw]] in 1945, and worked at the Museum of Natural History there while a student. She later pursued doctoral studies there. Zlotorzycka became head of the University's Department of General Parasitology in 1972.<ref name="P&V bio">{{cite journal |last1=Troyo |first1=Adriana |last2=González-Sequeira |first2=María Paula |last3=Aguirre-Salazar |first3=Mónica |last4=Cambronero-Ortíz |first4=Ian |last5=Chaves-González |first5=Luis Enrique |last6=Mejías-Alpízar |first6=María José |last7=Alvarado-Molina |first7=Kendall |last8=Calderón-Arguedas |first8=Ólger |last9=Rojas-Araya |first9=Diana |title=Acknowledging extraordinary women in the history of medical entomology |journal=Parasites & Vectors |date=31 March 2022 |volume=15 |issue=1 |page=114 |doi=10.1186/s13071-022-05234-6|pmid=35361284 |pmc=8969321 |doi-access=free }}</ref>
